findings.desc: quality-cleanup: story-owner-lease-doctor.ts:59 defines a private `formatAge` function that is an exact duplicate of the exported `formatLeaseAge` in story-owner-lease.ts. The comment at line 55 claims the reason is "so the doctor module does not depend on a non-exported internal" — but `formatLeaseAge` IS exported (story-owner-lease.ts:722 `export function formatLeaseAge`). The duplication means a future divergence in formatting logic (e.g. adding day-level display) must be patched in two places. Should import `formatLeaseAge` from story-owner-lease.ts and delete the private copy.
